## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — a new capability
- [ ] `fix` — a bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `refactor` — restructuring with no change in behavior
- [ ] `chore` — tooling, dependencies and CI

## Checklist

- [ ] The base branch is set to `development`
- [ ] The full test suite passes locally (`pytest`)
- [ ] New or changed behavior is covered by a test
- [ ] Docstrings are updated for any change to the public API
- [ ] Commits are prefixed per CONTRIBUTING.md
